question: The Criminal Procedure ________ allows police officers or prison officers to collect certain identifiable information (such as fingerprints, and biological samples) from convicts or those who have been arrested for an offense.
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Identification Act, of 2022.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Identification Act, of 2022 allows police officers or prison officers to collect certain identifiable information from convicts or those who have been arrested for an offense**.
 
• The Criminal Procedure refers to the set of rules and regulations that govern the process of criminal trials and investigations.
 
• This identifiable information includes fingerprints, biological samples, and other personal information that can be used to identify the individual.
 
• **Key Features of the Criminal Procedure (Identification) Act 2022**
 
 
• The measurements that can be taken include:
 
 
• Fingerprints impressions
 
• Palm prints and footprints
 
• Photos
 
• Iris and retina scans
 
• Analysis of physical and biological samples
 
• Behavioral attributes
 
• Signature and Handwriting
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Criminal Procedure refers to the set of rules and regulations that govern the process of criminal trials and investigations.
 
• The Identification Act, of 2022 is an important law that allows law enforcement officials to collect and use identifiable information to solve crimes and bring criminals to justice.
 
• The Samples Act, of 2022 is a hypothetical law and does not exist in reality.
 
• The Punishment Act, of 2022 is also a hypothetical law and does not exist in reality.
 
• The Marks Act, 2021 is not relevant to the given question and does not exist in reality.
